summary: Phase 4 changes introduce no security regressions. The refactored script retains the same CLI surface (--dry-run, default rewrite) and the same filesystem access pattern (recursive walk under the configured scanRoots). The new pure-function exports (findBlueprintFiles, removeConceptBlueprints, countConceptBlueprints, remediate) operate on caller-supplied paths and parsed JSON only — no eval, no shell-out, no dynamic require. The projection source change adds no I/O, no string interpolation, no surface area. The new test files use vitest's standard describe/it/expect and the node:fs / node:os / node:path modules for fixture management only — no network, no shell, no exec.

Path traversal.notes: The script's walk is bounded by the caller-supplied scanRoots (default ['apps']). It does not follow symlinks (fs.readdirSync with withFileTypes only). The script writes back to the same files it reads; no path is constructed from blueprint content.

Injection / XSS / SQL.notes: No string interpolation of user input into paths, commands, or queries. The script reads JSON, mutates the in-memory object, and writes JSON.stringify back. No regex execution against blueprint content (the .concept. pattern is a fixed string, not a user-supplied regex).

Filesystem safety.notes: findBlueprintFiles checks fs.existsSync before each walk. Test fixtures use fs.mkdtempSync under os.tmpdir() and clean up via fs.rmSync with recursive + force. No writes outside the temp dir. The production dry-run mode does not write any files.

Process spawn / shell.notes: No child_process, no exec, no spawn. The script runs entirely in-process.

Determinism.notes: The walker output is deterministic (alphabetical entry order from readdirSync). The detector is a fixed regex. The projection sorts output by nodeId then mode — already in place pre-Phase-4, preserved by the change.

Unsafe patterns.notes: No eval, no new Function, no Object.assign on untrusted input, no prototype pollution surface. The BlueprintFile parsed object is filtered with .filter() (no mutation of untrusted object structure beyond array element removal).

Auth / authorization.notes: N/A — Phase 4 does not touch any auth, session, or authorization code. The pre-calculus skill graph and activity-map.json are static curriculum artifacts; the script does not consume any user-supplied data.

Dependency changes.notes: No new dependencies. The script uses only node:fs, node:path, node:url (Node built-ins). The vitest config uses vitest, @vitest/config (already in the repo for other packages). No npm install required.

tests_run: npx tsx scripts/remediate-concept-blueprints.ts --dry-run (no writes; output is deterministic; no path appears outside the apps/ subtree)
handoff: Phase 4 is security-clean. No new attack surface, no new dependencies, no shell-out, no eval, no path traversal. The script remains a single-purpose read-mutate-write tool bounded by the configured scanRoots. The projection change is a pure data-flow refactor (sibling iteration instead of single-skill collapse). Phase 5 (IM3 auth unification) can proceed.
